shloka_text: तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा राघवस्य महात्मनः । कुम्भयोनिर्मिहातेजा राममेतदुवाच ह ।। 7.2.1 ।।
transliteration: tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā rāghavasya mahātmanaḥ | kumbhayonirmihātejā rāmametaduvāca ha || 7.2.1 ||
translation: तस्य his, तत् that, वचनं word, श्रुत्वा having heard, राघवस्य of Rama, महात्मनः of the great-souled, कुम्भयोनिः Agastya, महातेजाः greatly effulgent, रामम् to Rama, एतत् this, उवाच said, ह indeed
explanation: Having heard those words of the great-souled Rama, the greatly effulgent sage Agastya then spoke this to Rama.
comments: Agastya begins the account of Ravana's lineage -- the sage Pulastya, son of Brahma, disturbed in his penance by maidens, curses that any maiden he sees shall conceive -- the daughter of the royal sage Trnabindu is thus afflicted and given by her father to Pulastya -- pleased by her service, the sage grants her a son, Vishravas, born endowed with fame and righteousness.

shloka_text: शृणु राम कथावृत्तं तस्य तेजोबलं महत् । जघान शत्रून्येनासौ न च वध्यः स शत्रुभिः ।। 7.2.2 ।।
transliteration: śṛṇu rāma kathāvṛttaṃ tasya tejobalaṃ mahat | jaghāna śatrūnyenāsau na ca vadhyaḥ sa śatrubhiḥ || 7.2.2 ||
translation: शृणु listen, राम O Rama, कथावृत्तं the story, तस्य his, तेजोबलं might and power, महत् great, जघान killed, शत्रून् enemies, येन by which, असौ he, न च and not, वध्यः to be killed, सः he, शत्रुभिः by enemies
explanation: O Rama, listen to his story, his great might and power, by which he killed his enemies and could not be killed by them.

shloka_text: तावत्ते रावणस्येदं कुलं जन्म च राघव । वरप्रदानं च तथा तस्मै दत्तं ब्रवीमि ते ।। 7.2.3 ।।
transliteration: tāvatte rāvaṇasyedaṃ kulaṃ janma ca rāghava | varapradānaṃ ca tathā tasmai dattaṃ bravīmi te || 7.2.3 ||
translation: तावत् then, ते to you, रावणस्य of Ravana, इदं this, कुलं lineage, जन्म birth, च and, राघव O Raghava, वरप्रदानं granting of boons, च and, तथा thus, तस्मै to him, दत्तं given, ब्रवीमि I will tell, ते to you
explanation: O Raghava, I will now tell you about Ravana's lineage, his birth, and the boons that were granted to him.

shloka_text: पुरा कृतयुगे राम प्रजापतिसुतः प्रभुः । पुलस्त्यो नाम ब्रह्मर्षिः साक्षादिव पितामहः ।। 7.2.4 ।।
transliteration: purā kṛtayuge rāma prajāpatisutaḥ prabhuḥ | pulastyo nāma brahmarṣiḥ sākṣādiva pitāmahaḥ || 7.2.4 ||
translation: पुरा formerly, कृतयुगे in the Krita Yuga, राम O Rama, प्रजापतिसुतः son of Prajapati, प्रभुः the powerful one, पुलस्त्यो नाम named Pulastya, ब्रह्मर्षिः a Brahmarshi, साक्षादिव as if directly, पितामहः the grandfather (Brahma).
explanation: O Rama, formerly in the Krita Yuga, there was a powerful Brahmarshi named Pulastya, the son of Prajapati, who was verily like Brahma himself.

shloka_text: नानुकीर्त्या गुणास्तस्य धर्मतः शीलतस्तथा । प्रजापतेः पुत्र इति वक्तुं शक्यं हि नामतः ।। 7.2.5 ।।
transliteration: nānukīrtyā guṇāstasya dharmataḥ śīlatastathā | prajāpateḥ putra iti vaktuṃ śakyaṃ hi nāmataḥ || 7.2.5 ||
translation: न not, अनुकीर्त्या to be fully described, गुणाः qualities, तस्य his, धर्मतः in terms of righteousness, शीलतः in terms of character, तथा and, प्रजापतेः of Prajapati, पुत्रः son, इति thus, वक्तुं to say, शक्यं possible, हि indeed, नामतः by name.
explanation: His qualities, in terms of righteousness and character, could not be fully described; indeed, it was only possible to refer to him by name as the son of Prajapati.

shloka_text: प्रजापतिसुतत्वेन देवानां वल्लभो हि सः । हृष्टः सर्वस्य लोकस्य गुणैः शुभ्रैर्महामतिः ।। 7.2.6 ।।
transliteration: prajāpatisutatvena devānāṃ vallabho hi saḥ | hṛṣṭaḥ sarvasya lokasya guṇaiḥ śubhrairmahāmatiḥ || 7.2.6 ||
translation: प्रजापतिसुतत्वेन by virtue of being the son of Prajapati, देवानां of the gods, वल्लभः beloved, हि indeed, सः he, हृष्टः pleased, सर्वस्य of all, लोकस्य the world, गुणैः by qualities, शुभ्रैः pure, महामतिः the great-minded one.
explanation: Indeed, by virtue of being the son of Prajapati, he was beloved by the gods and, being great-minded, he gladdened all the world with his pure qualities.

shloka_text: स तु धर्मप्रसङ्गेन मेरोः पार्श्वे महागिरेः । तृणविन्द्वाश्रमं गत्वा न्यवसन्मुनिपुङ्गवः ।। 7.2.7 ।।
transliteration: sa tu dharmaprasaṅgena meroḥ pārśve mahāgireḥ | tṛṇavindvāśramaṃ gatvā nyavasanmunipuṅgavaḥ || 7.2.7 ||
translation: सः he, तु indeed, धर्मप्रसङ्गेन for religious purposes, मेरोः of Mount Meru, पार्श्वे on the side, महागिरेः of the great mountain, तृणविन्द्वाश्रमं to the hermitage of Tṛṇavindu, गत्वा having gone, न्यवसत् resided, मुनिपुङ्गवः the foremost among sages.
explanation: Indeed, for religious purposes, that foremost sage went to the hermitage of Tṛṇavindu on the side of the great Mount Meru and resided there.

shloka_text: तपस्तेपे स धर्मात्मा स्वाध्यायनियतेन्द्रियः । गत्वाश्रमपदं तस्य विघ्नं कुर्वन्ति कन्यकाः ।। 7.2.8 ।।
transliteration: tapastepe sa dharmātmā svādhyāyaniyatendriyaḥ | gatvāśramapadaṃ tasya vighnaṃ kurvanti kanyakāḥ || 7.2.8 ||
translation: सः he, धर्मात्मा the righteous-souled one, स्वाध्यायनियतेन्द्रियः with senses controlled by Vedic study, तपः तेपे performed penance, गत्वा having gone, आश्रमपदं to the hermitage, तस्य his, विघ्नं disturbance, कुर्वन्ति they make, कन्यकाः maidens.
explanation: That righteous-souled sage, with his senses controlled by Vedic study, performed severe penance, but maidens would go to his hermitage and create disturbances.

shloka_text: देवपन्नगकन्याश्च राजर्षितनयाश्च याः । क्रीडन्त्यो ऽप्सरसश्चैव तं देशमुपपेदिरे ।। 7.2.9 ।।
transliteration: devapannagakanyāśca rājarṣitanayāśca yāḥ | krīḍantyo 'psarasaścaiva taṃ deśamupapedire || 7.2.9 ||
translation: देवपन्नगकन्याश्च daughters of gods and serpents, राजर्षितनयाश्च and daughters of royal sages, याः who, क्रीडन्त्यो playing, अप्सरसश्चैव and Apsaras too, तं that, देशम् place, उपपेदिरे reached.
explanation: Daughters of gods, serpents, and royal sages, along with Apsaras, arrived at that place to play.

shloka_text: सर्वर्तुषृपभोग्यत्वाद्रम्यत्वात्काननस्य च । नित्यशस्तास्तु तं देशं गत्वा क्रीडन्ति कन्यकाः ।। 7.2.10 ।।
transliteration: sarvartuṣṛpabhogyatvādramyatvātkānanasya ca | nityaśastāstu taṃ deśaṃ gatvā krīḍanti kanyakāḥ || 7.2.10 ||
translation: सर्वर्तुषृपभोग्यत्वात् due to being enjoyable in all seasons, रम्यत्वात् due to beauty, काननस्य च and of the forest, नित्यशस्तास्तु always, तं that, देशम् place, गत्वा having gone, क्रीडन्ति play, कन्यकाः maidens.
explanation: Because the forest was beautiful and enjoyable in all seasons, these maidens always went to that place to play.

shloka_text: देशस्य रमणीयत्वात्पुलस्त्यो यत्र स द्विजः । गायन्त्यो वादयन्त्यश्च लासयन्त्यस्तथैव च । मुनेस्तपस्विनस्तस्य विघ्नं चक्रुरनिन्दिताः ।। 7.2.11 ।।
transliteration: deśasya ramaṇīyatvātpulastyo yatra sa dvijaḥ | gāyantyo vādayantyaśca lāsayantyastathaiva ca | munestapasvinastasya vighnaṃ cakruraninditāḥ || 7.2.11 ||
translation: देशस्य of the place, रमणीयत्वात् due to beauty, पुलस्त्यो Pulastya, यत्र where, स he, द्विजः brahmin, गायन्त्यो singing, वादयन्त्यश्च and playing instruments, लासयन्त्यस्तथैव च and dancing thus, मुनेः of the sage, तपस्विनस्तस्य of that ascetic, विघ्नं obstruction, चक्रुः caused, अनिन्दिताः blameless (maidens).
explanation: Due to the beauty of the place where the brahmin Pulastya resided, the blameless maidens, by singing, playing instruments, and dancing, caused an obstruction to that ascetic sage.

shloka_text: अथ क्रुद्धो महातेजा व्याजहार महामुनिः । या मे दर्शनमागच्छेत्सा गर्भं धारयिष्यति ।। 7.2.12 ।।
transliteration: atha kruddho mahātejā vyājahāra mahāmuniḥ | yā me darśanamāgacchetsā garbhaṃ dhārayiṣyati || 7.2.12 ||
translation: अथ then, क्रुद्धो angered, महातेजा greatly effulgent, व्याजहार spoke, महामुनिः the great sage, या whoever, मे my, दर्शनम् sight, आगच्छेत् comes, सा she, गर्भं a fetus, धारयिष्यति will bear.
explanation: Then, the greatly effulgent great sage, being angered, declared, "Whoever comes into my sight will conceive a child."

shloka_text: तास्तु सर्वाः प्रतिश्रुत्य तस्य वाक्यं महात्मनः । ब्रह्मशापभयाद्भीतास्तं देशं नोपचक्रमुः ।। 7.2.13 ।।
transliteration: tāstu sarvāḥ pratiśrutya tasya vākyaṃ mahātmanaḥ | brahmaśāpabhayādbhītāstaṃ deśaṃ nopacakramuḥ || 7.2.13 ||
translation: तास्तु but they, सर्वाः all, प्रतिश्रुत्य having heard, तस्य his, वाक्यं words, महात्मनः of the great soul, ब्रह्मशापभयात् from fear of the brahmin's curse, भीताः frightened, तं that, देशं place, न not, उपचक्रमुः approached.
explanation: But all of them, having heard the words of that great soul, were frightened by the brahmin's curse and no longer approached that place.

shloka_text: तृणबिन्दोस्तु राजर्षेस्तनया न शृणोति तत् ।। 7.2.14 ।।
transliteration: tṛṇabindostu rājarṣestanayā na śṛṇoti tat || 7.2.14 ||
translation: तृणबिन्दोः of Tṛṇabindu, तु indeed, राजर्षेः of the royal sage, तनया daughter, न not, शृणोति hears, तत् that
explanation: But the daughter of the royal sage Tṛṇabindu did not hear that.

shloka_text: गत्वाश्रमपदं तत्र विचचार सुनिर्भया । न सापश्यत्स्थिता तत्र काञ्चिदभ्यागतां सखीम् ।। 7.2.15 ।।
transliteration: gatvāśramapadaṃ tatra vicacāra sunirbhayā | na sāpaśyatsthitā tatra kāñcidabhyāgatāṃ sakhīm || 7.2.15 ||
translation: गत्वा having gone, आश्रमपदम् to the hermitage, तत्र there, विचचार she wandered, सुनिर्भया very fearlessly, न not, सा she, अपश्यत् saw, स्थिता present, तत्र there, काञ्चित् any, अभ्यागताम् arrived, सखीम् friend
explanation: Having gone to the hermitage, she wandered there very fearlessly, but she did not see any friend present or arrived there.

shloka_text: तस्मिन्काले महातेजाः प्राजापत्यो महानृषिः । स्वाध्यायमकरोत्तत्र तपसा भावितः स्वयम् ।। 7.2.16 ।।
transliteration: tasminkāle mahātejāḥ prājāpatyo mahānṛṣiḥ | svādhyāyamakarottatra tapasā bhāvitaḥ svayam || 7.2.16 ||
translation: तस्मिन् in that, काले time, महातेजाः greatly effulgent, प्राजापत्यः son of Prajāpati, महानृषिः great sage, स्वाध्यायम् self-study, अकरोत् he performed, तत्र there, तपसा by penance, भावितः purified, स्वयम् himself
explanation: At that time, the greatly effulgent great sage, son of Prajāpati, purified by his own penance, was performing self-study of the Vedas there.

shloka_text: सा तु वेदश्रुतिं श्रुत्वा दृष्ट्वा वै तपसो निधिम् । अभवत्पाण्डुदेहा सा सुव्यञ्जितशरीरजा ।। 7.2.17 ।।
transliteration: sā tu vedaśrutiṃ śrutvā dṛṣṭvā vai tapaso nidhim | abhavatpāṇḍudehā sā suvyañjitaśarīrajā || 7.2.17 ||
translation: सा she, तु but, वेदश्रुतिम् the sound of the Vedas, श्रुत्वा having heard, दृष्ट्वा having seen, वै indeed, तपसः of penance, निधिम् the treasure, अभवत् she became, पाण्डुदेहा pale-bodied, सा she, सुव्यञ्जितशरीरजा with clearly manifested bodily signs
explanation: But she, having heard the sound of the Vedas and indeed having seen the repository of penance, became pale-bodied with clearly manifested bodily signs.

shloka_text: वभूव च समुद्विग्ना दृष्ट्वा तद्दोषमात्मनः । इदं मे किन्त्विति ज्ञात्वा पितुर्गत्वा ऽ ऽश्रमे स्थिता ।। 7.2.18 ।।
transliteration: vabhūva ca samudvignā dṛṣṭvā taddoṣamātmanaḥ | idaṃ me kintviti jñātvā piturgatvā ' 'śrame sthitā || 7.2.18 ||
translation: वभूव she became, च and, समुद्विग्ना agitated, दृष्ट्वा having seen, तत् that, दोषम् fault, आत्मनः of herself, इदम् this, मे to me, किन्तु what (is this), इति thus, ज्ञात्वा having known, पितुः of her father, गत्वा having gone, आश्रमे in the hermitage, स्थिता she stayed
explanation: And she became agitated, having seen that fault in herself, and understanding "what is this that has happened to me?", she went and stayed in her father's hermitage.

shloka_text: तां तु दृष्ट्वा तथाभूतां तृणविन्दुरथाब्रवीत् । किं त्वमेतत्त्वसदृशं धारयस्यात्मनो वपुः ।। 7.2.19 ।।
transliteration: tāṃ tu dṛṣṭvā tathābhūtāṃ tṛṇavindurathābravīt | kiṃ tvametattvasadṛśaṃ dhārayasyātmano vapuḥ || 7.2.19 ||
translation: तां her, तु indeed, दृष्ट्वा having seen, तथाभूतां in that state, तृणविन्दुः Tṛṇabindu, अथ then, अब्रवीत् spoke, किं why, त्वम् you, एतत् this, त्वसदृशं unbefitting you, धारयसि bear, आत्मनः your own, वपुः body.
explanation: Seeing her in such a transformed state, Tṛṇabindu then asked her why she was bearing a form so unbefitting her true self.

shloka_text: सा तु कृत्वाञ्जलिं दीना कन्योवाच तपोधनम् । न जाने कारणं तात येन मे रूपमीदृशम् ।। 7.2.20 ।।
transliteration: sā tu kṛtvāñjaliṃ dīnā kanyovāca tapodhanam | na jāne kāraṇaṃ tāta yena me rūpamīdṛśam || 7.2.20 ||
translation: सा she, तु indeed, कृत्वा having made, अञ्जलिं a respectful salutation, दीना distressed, कन्या the maiden, उवाच spoke, तपोधनम् to the ascetic, न not, जाने I know, कारणं the reason, तात O father, येन by which, मे my, रूपम् form, ईदृशम् is like this.
explanation: The distressed maiden, having respectfully saluted the ascetic, replied that she did not know the reason, O father, why her form had become like this.

shloka_text: किं तु पूर्वं गतास्म्येका महर्षेर्भावितात्मनः । पुलस्त्यस्याश्रमं दिव्यमन्वेष्टुं स्वसखीजनम् ।। 7.2.21 ।।
transliteration: kiṃ tu pūrvaṃ gatāsmyekā maharṣerbhāvitātmanaḥ | pulastyasyāśramaṃ divyamanveṣṭuṃ svasakhījanam || 7.2.21 ||
translation: किं तु but, पूर्वं previously, गतास्मि I went, एका alone, महर्षेः of the great sage, भावितात्मनः whose soul is purified, पुलस्त्यस्य of Pulastya, आश्रमं to the hermitage, दिव्यम् divine, अन्वेष्टुं to search for, स्वसखीजनम् my female companions.
explanation: However, she continued, previously she had gone alone to the divine hermitage of the great sage Pulastya, whose soul was purified, to search for her female companions.

shloka_text: न च पश्याम्यहं तत्र काञ्चिदभ्यागतां सखीम् । रूपस्य तु विपर्यासं दृष्ट्वा त्रासादिहागता ।। 7.2.22 ।।
transliteration: na ca paśyāmyahaṃ tatra kāñcidabhyāgatāṃ sakhīm | rūpasya tu viparyāsaṃ dṛṣṭvā trāsādihāgatā || 7.2.22 ||
translation: न not, च and, पश्यामि I see, अहं I, तत्र there, काञ्चित् any, अभ्यागतां arrived, सखीम् friend, रूपस्य of the form, तु but, विपर्यासं transformation, दृष्ट्वा having seen, त्रासात् from fear, इह here, आगता I came.
explanation: She added that she did not see any of her friends who had arrived there, but having seen the transformation of her own form, she came here out of fear.

shloka_text: तृणबिन्दुस्तु राजर्षिस्तपसा द्योतितप्रभः । ध्यानं विवेश तच्चापि ह्यपश्यदृषिकर्मजम् ।। 7.2.23 ।।
transliteration: tṛṇabindustu rājarṣistapasā dyotitaprabhaḥ | dhyānaṃ viveśa taccāpi hyapaśyadṛṣikarmajam || 7.2.23 ||
translation: तृणबिन्दुः Tṛṇabindu, तु indeed, राजर्षिः the royal sage, तपसा by penance, द्योतितप्रभः whose splendor was illuminated, ध्यानं meditation, विवेश entered, तत् that, च and, अपि also, हि indeed, अपश्यत् he saw, ऋषिकर्मजम् born of a sage's action.
explanation: The royal sage Tṛṇabindu, whose splendor was illuminated by his penance, then entered into meditation and indeed perceived that the transformation was due to a sage's action.

shloka_text: स तु विज्ञाय तं शापं महर्षेर्भावितात्मनः । गृहीत्वा तनयां गत्वा पुलस्त्यमिदमब्रवीत् ।। 7.2.24 ।।
transliteration: sa tu vijñāya taṃ śāpaṃ maharṣerbhāvitātmanaḥ | gṛhītvā tanayāṃ gatvā pulastyamidamabravīt || 7.2.24 ||
translation: सः He, तु indeed, विज्ञाय having understood, तम् that, शापम् curse, महर्षेः of the great sage, भावितात्मनः of the self-realized one, गृहीत्वा having taken, तनयाम् his daughter, गत्वा having gone, पुलस्त्यम् to Pulastya, इदम् this, अब्रवीत् he said.
explanation: King Trasabindu, having understood the curse from the great self-realized sage, took his daughter and went to Pulastya, to whom he spoke these words.

shloka_text: भगवंस्तनयां मे त्वं गुणैः स्वैरेव भूषिताम् । भिक्षां प्रतिगृहाणेमां महर्षे स्वयमुद्यताम् ।। 7.2.25 ।।
transliteration: bhagavaṃstanayāṃ me tvaṃ guṇaiḥ svaireva bhūṣitām | bhikṣāṃ pratigṛhāṇemāṃ maharṣe svayamudyatām || 7.2.25 ||
translation: भगवन् O revered one, तनयाम् daughter, मे my, त्वम् you, गुणैः with qualities, स्वैः her own, एव indeed, भूषिताम् adorned, भिक्षाम् alms, प्रतिगृहाण please accept, इमाम् this, महर्षे O great sage, स्वयम् by herself, उद्यताम् offered.
explanation: O revered great sage, please accept this daughter of mine, adorned with her own virtues, as an offering that she herself is ready to make.

shloka_text: तपश्चरणयुक्तस्य श्रम्यमाणेन्द्रियस्य ते । शुश्रूषणपरा नित्यं भविष्यति न संशयः ।। 7.2.26 ।।
transliteration: tapaścaraṇayuktasya śramyamāṇendriyasya te | śuśrūṣaṇaparā nityaṃ bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ || 7.2.26 ||
translation: तपश्चरणयुक्तस्य of one engaged in ascetic practices, श्रम्यमाणेन्द्रियस्य of one whose senses are fatigued, ते your, शुश्रूषणपरा devoted to service, नित्यम् always, भविष्यति she will be, न no, संशयः doubt.
explanation: She will undoubtedly always be devoted to serving you, whose senses are fatigued from engaging in ascetic practices.

shloka_text: तं ब्रुवाणं तु तद्वाक्यं राजर्षिं धार्मिकं तदा । जिघृक्षुरब्रवीत्कन्यां बाढमित्येव स द्विजः ।। 7.2.27 ।।
transliteration: taṃ bruvāṇaṃ tu tadvākyaṃ rājarṣiṃ dhārmikaṃ tadā | jighṛkṣurabravītkanyāṃ bāḍhamityeva sa dvijaḥ || 7.2.27 ||
translation: तम् to him, ब्रुवाणम् who was speaking, तु indeed, तद्वाक्यम् those words, राजर्षिम् to the royal sage, धार्मिकम् righteous, तदा then, जिघृक्षुः desirous of taking, अब्रवीत् he said, कन्याम् the daughter, बाढम् certainly, इति thus, एव indeed, सः that, द्विजः brahmin.
explanation: Then, that brahmin (Pulastya), wishing to accept the daughter, said "Certainly, yes" to the righteous royal sage who was speaking those words.

shloka_text: दत्त्वा स तु यथान्यायं स्वमाश्रमपदं गतः । सापि तत्रावसत्कन्या तोषयन्ती पतिं गुणैः ।। 7.2.28 ।।
transliteration: dattvā sa tu yathānyāyaṃ svamāśramapadaṃ gataḥ | sāpi tatrāvasatkanyā toṣayantī patiṃ guṇaiḥ || 7.2.28 ||
translation: दत्त्वा having given, सः he, तु indeed, यथान्यायम् according to custom, स्वम् his own, आश्रमपदम् hermitage, गतः went, सा she, अपि also, तत्र there, अवसत् lived, कन्या the daughter, तोषयन्ती pleasing, पतिम् her husband, गुणैः with her virtues.
explanation: Having properly given his daughter, King Trasabindu returned to his own hermitage, and the daughter also lived there, pleasing her husband with her virtues.

shloka_text: तस्यास्तु शीलवृत्ताभ्यां तुतोष मुनिपुङ्गवः । प्रीतः स तु महातेजा वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह ।। 7.2.29 ।।
transliteration: tasyāstu śīlavṛttābhyāṃ tutoṣa munipuṅgavaḥ | prītaḥ sa tu mahātejā vākyametaduvāca ha || 7.2.29 ||
translation: तस्याः her, तु indeed, शीलवृत्ताभ्यां by character and conduct, तुतोष was pleased, मुनिपुङ्गवः the excellent sage, प्रीतः pleased, स he, तु indeed, महातेजा the greatly effulgent one, वाक्यम् words, एतत् these, उवाच spoke, ह indeed.
explanation: The excellent sage Pulastya was greatly pleased by her character and conduct, and being delighted, the greatly effulgent one spoke these words.

shloka_text: परितुष्टो ऽस्मि सुश्रोणि गुणानां सम्पदा भृशम् । तस्माद्देवि ददाम्यद्य पुत्रमात्मसमं तव ।। 7.2.30 ।।
transliteration: parituṣṭo 'smi suśroṇi guṇānāṃ sampadā bhṛśam | tasmāddevi dadāmyadya putramātmasamaṃ tava || 7.2.30 ||
translation: परितुष्टः completely satisfied, अस्मि I am, सुश्रोणि O beautiful-hipped one, गुणानाम् of qualities, सम्पदा by abundance, भृशम् exceedingly, तस्मात् therefore, देवि O goddess, ददामि I give, अद्य today, पुत्रम् a son, आत्मसमम् equal to myself, तव to you.
explanation: O beautiful-hipped one, I am exceedingly pleased by your abundance of virtues; therefore, O goddess, I grant you today a son equal to myself.

shloka_text: उभयोर्वंशकर्तारं पौलस्त्य इति विश्रुतम् । यस्मात्तु विश्रुतो वेदस्त्वयैषो ऽध्ययतो मम ।। 7.2.31 ।।
transliteration: ubhayorvaṃśakartāraṃ paulastya iti viśrutam | yasmāttu viśruto vedastvayaiṣo 'dhyayato mama || 7.2.31 ||
translation: उभयोः of both, वंशकर्तारम् the progenitor of the lineage, पौलस्त्यः Pulastya, इति thus, विश्रुतम् renowned, यस्मात् because, तु indeed, विश्रुतः heard, वेदः the Veda, त्वया by you, एषः this, अध्ययतः while studying, मम my.
explanation: He will be renowned as the progenitor of both our lineages, and because you heard this Veda while I was reciting it.

shloka_text: तस्मात्स विश्रवा नाम भविष्यति न संशयः । एवमुक्ता तु सा देवी प्रहृष्टेनान्तरात्मना ।। 7.2.32 ।।
transliteration: tasmātsa viśravā nāma bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ | evamuktā tu sā devī prahṛṣṭenāntarātmanā || 7.2.32 ||
translation: तस्मात् therefore, स he, विश्रवा Vishrava, नाम named, भविष्यति will be, न not, संशयः doubt, एवम् thus, उक्ता spoken to, तु indeed, सा she, देवी the goddess, प्रहृष्टेन delighted, अन्तरात्मना with her inner self.
explanation: Therefore, he will undoubtedly be named Vishrava; thus addressed, that goddess, with a delighted heart.

shloka_text: अचिरेणैव कालेनासूत विश्रवसं सुतम् । त्रिषु लोकेषु विख्यातं यशोधर्मसमन्वितम् ।। 7.2.33 ।।
transliteration: acireṇaiva kālenāsūta viśravasaṃ sutam | triṣu lokeṣu vikhyātaṃ yaśodharmasamanvitam || 7.2.33 ||
translation: अचिरेण in a short time, एव indeed, कालेन by time, असूत gave birth, विश्रवसम् Vishravas, सुतम् a son, त्रिषु in three, लोकेषु worlds, विख्यातं renowned, यशोधर्मसमन्वितम् endowed with fame and righteousness.
explanation: In a short time, she gave birth to a son named Vishravas, who became renowned in the three worlds and was endowed with fame and righteousness.

shloka_text: श्रुतिमान्समदर्शी च व्रताचाररतस्तथा । पितेव तपसा युक्तो ह्यभवद्विश्रवा मुनिः ।। 7.2.34 ।।
transliteration: śrutimānsamadarśī ca vratācāraratastathā | piteva tapasā yukto hyabhavadviśravā muniḥ || 7.2.34 ||
translation: श्रुतिमान् possessed of scriptural knowledge, समदर्शी one who sees all equally, च and, व्रताचाररतः devoted to vows and observances, तथा also, पिता इव like his father, तपसा with austerity, युक्तः endowed, हि indeed, अभवत् became, विश्रवाः Vishrava, मुनिः a sage.
explanation: Sage Vishrava became learned in scriptures, impartial, devoted to vows and observances, and indeed, like his father, engaged in severe austerities. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे द्वितीयः सर्गः ।। 2 ।। Thus ends the second sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
